plan_item: 77.44.7.B — native keyboard selection across Rich Text blocks
finding: The latest Rich Text evidence covered native mouse selection across paragraphs and list items, mobile browser selection, IME composition, paste, and backward anchor/focus restoration. It did not separately exercise a native keyboard-extended Shift+Arrow selection crossing paragraph boundaries.
change: Added a focused real-Chromium test that places a caret, creates forward and backward multi-paragraph ranges with native Shift+ArrowRight/Shift+ArrowLeft keyboard input, and checks the canonical Page Model segments and direction.
The test applies inline marks through the existing Inspector command and verifies that its DOM rerender retains selection text and direction.
The desktop mock-API lifecycle verifies draft Save does not publish, a later explicit Publish does, and the public renderer outputs the same selected inline marks.
Regenerated the existing 396-feature source-candidate crosswalk so this new browser test appears under the existing Editor acceptance candidates. No runtime source changed.
